name: x25519
description: X25519/Ed25519 link-key derivation and clamping test vectors. Verifies RFC 8032 clamping is correctly applied during key generation, that the full seed->key-material bundle (Ed25519 keypair, X25519 static DH public, IID, native 02xx address) is consistent and deterministic (consumers MUST derive each bundle twice and require identical bytes across calls), and that non-32-byte seeds are rejected.

vectors.name: clamping_zero_seed
vectors.description: Seed all-zeros: verifies clamping clears bits 0,1,2 of byte[0], sets bit 6, clears bit 7 of byte[31]

vectors.name: clamping_ones_seed
vectors.description: Seed all-ones (0xff): verifies clamping forces correct bit pattern on high-entropy hash output

clamping_checks.note: Raw hash byte0=0x27 becomes 0x20 (clear bits 0-2), byte31=0x97 becomes 0x57 (set bit6, clear bit7)

vectors.name: clamping_rfc8032_test_vector
vectors.description: RFC 8032 Section 7.1 test vector 1: verifies key derivation matches standard
vectors.note: SHA-512 of empty message signed with this key is the RFC 8032 test signature. public_key is the RFC 8032 constant (external anchor). iid/ygg_addr match test/vectors/yggdrasil-derivation.json vector 3; x25519_public cross-checked with the cryptography-library X25519 implementation.

vectors.name: invalid_seed_length_empty
vectors.description: Empty seed MUST be rejected by both derive_keypair() and Identity.from_seed()

vectors.name: invalid_seed_length_31
vectors.description: 31-byte (one short) seed MUST be rejected by both derive_keypair() and Identity.from_seed()

vectors.name: invalid_seed_length_33
vectors.description: 33-byte (one long) seed MUST be rejected by both derive_keypair() and Identity.from_seed()
